2013. Notification System Using Abstract Class and Interface

90

Hard

Problem Statement

Create an interface Notification with a method send(String message).

Create an abstract class BaseNotification that implements the Notification interface and contains a common method displayMessage().

Create three classes:

EmailNotification
SMSNotification
PushNotification

Each class should override the send() method and display the notification type along with the message.
input_spec:
The first line contains the notification type: email, sms, or push.

The second line contains the message.
output_spec: Print the notification type followed by the message.
